map.由引力常数与轨道半径求速度 使用指南: Deriving Velocity from the Gravitational Parameter and Orbital Radius User Guide
map.圆轨道速度计算器，输入引力参数 μ 与轨道半径 r，按 v=√(μ/r) 求圆轨: The circular orbital velocity calculator takes the gravitational parameter mu and the orbital radius r and computes v = sqrt(mu/r) for the circular orbital velocity, used for satellite insertion and transfer parameter calculations.
map.输入引力参数 μ 与轨道半径 r，求圆轨道速度。: Enter the gravitational parameter mu and the orbital radius r to find the circular orbital velocity.
map.圆轨道速度 v=√(μ/r)，用于入轨速度规划。: Circular orbital velocity v = sqrt(mu/r), used for insertion velocity planning.
map.对比低轨/高轨速度，评估变轨所需 Δv。: Compare low-orbit and high-orbit velocities to assess the delta-v needed for a transfer.
map.由目标轨道高度反推需要达到的速度。: Back out the velocity needed from a target orbital altitude.
map.：轨道半径 r=6.77×10⁶ m、μ=3.986×10¹⁴，圆轨道速度 v=: Orbital radius r = 6.77e6 m and mu = 3.986e14 give the circular orbital velocity v = sqrt(3.986e14/6.77e6) = sqrt(5.89e7) = about 7672 m/s, about 7.67 km/s, the order of the first cosmic velocity.

map.轨道速度和逃逸速度怎么记？: How do you remember orbital velocity and escape velocity?
map.圆轨道 v_c=√(μ/r)，逃逸 v_e=√2·v_c。近地 v_c≈7.9: For a circular orbit v_c = sqrt(mu/r) and escape v_e = sqrt(2) x v_c. Near Earth v_c is about 7.9 km/s and v_e about 11.2 km/s. Leaving Earth needs another delta-v of about 3.3 km/s from the orbital velocity (ideal, ignoring losses).
map.实际入轨速度就是这个值吗？: Is the actual insertion velocity exactly this value?
map.理论圆轨道速度如此，但火箭沿转移轨道入轨会有速度方向与大小的组合，且含重力/阻力: The theoretical circular orbital velocity is like this, but a rocket inserting along a transfer orbit has a combination of velocity direction and magnitude and also gravity and drag losses. This tool gives the ideal circular orbital velocity baseline.
